verdict.rationale: SigNoz's GitHub repo describes a free, open-source edition that runs in your own infrastructure via Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux, with full control of the data plane. Community users confirm a self-hosting option exists and has been tried, though they complain about the number of containers and configuration effort; one Windows install attempt failed on sh/bash dependencies. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party self-hosting install docs in the pack, documented Windows support, clarity on which features sit under the separately licensed ee/ directory, and a simpler footprint for small deployments.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Free open-source SigNoz that runs in your own infrastructure. Deploy with Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux and keep full control of your data plane.
They like SigNoz's self-hosting option and its OpenTelemetry basis.
